title: Thanks and goodbyes

blocks.x: Well we want to thank you gentlemen, and Frank Foster currently leading the Basie orchestra on tenor and soprano sax, and Bill Hughes holding down the bass trombone chair. It’s been a real pleasure talking to you and thanks a lot for your stories.
I think the Basie band is in good hands.
Thank you very much, I appreciate it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -23-
